EmailTemplate.name: Orientation
EmailTemplate.subject: Your ASU orientation experience
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
New Student Orientation is a one-day, on-campus program incoming students are expected to attend before the fall semester begins. Learn more at https://eoss.asu.edu/orientation.
During orientation, you will:
-meet with your academic college and learn about academic expectations -complete course selections and registration for the upcoming semester -meet with current students and new classmates -explore ways to get involved on campus -learn about the university’s services and resources -visit a residence hall community
If you are unable to attend orientation due to extenuating circumstances, please contact your academic advisor to discuss alternative class registration options. (There is no guarantee that a special accommodation can be made.) Your advisor's contact information can be found in My ASU at http://my.asu.edu/ under My Programs and eAdvisor.
Sincerely,
{!User.Recruiter_Full_Name__c} {!User.Recruiter_Title__c} Admission Services {!User.Recruiter_Email__c} {!User.Recruiter_Phone__c}
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
